result:
Everything's in order and verified. Summary of what I did:

- Added `apps/web/src/routes/overview.tsx`, a new route at `/overview` built from Astryx's `dashboard` template pattern, using `Layout`/`Grid`/`Card`/`Table`/`StatusDot`/`Icon` components (Phosphor semantic icons per this repo's theme, not Heroicons from the raw template).
- **Headline numbers**: 4 metric cards (total revenue, transactions, avg. basket size, CSAT) each with an up/down arrow vs. last week.
- **Weekly trend**: a line chart (this week vs. last week, Mon–Sun) — added `recharts` as a new dependency to `apps/web/package.json` since it's not in the workspace and Astryx has no built-in chart component (its own templates rely on recharts too).
- **Sites needing attention**: a compact table of the 4 sites down >5% week-over-week, worst first, with `StatusDot` severity and a reason column.
- Fixed lint issues from `vp check` (JSX-as-prop, strict-boolean-expressions, an invalid `Text` color) and replaced inline `style={{color}}` with StyleX `xstyle` per this repo's self-check rule.
- Verified with `vp run build`, `vp check --fix` (clean), and `vp preview` + fetching `/overview` — confirmed all the sample data renders correctly server-side.
